detail.deleteMessage: For an order entered by mistake: it disappears along with its stock withdrawal, as if it never existed. This cannot be undone.
detail.refundMessage: The customer gave the items back: they return to stock today and the order no longer counts in turnover. It stays in the history.

lines.unknownProductHint: Amount typed on the terminal without a product: it counts in the turnover, not in the stock.

margin.note: Before URSSAF contributions and event expenses.

identify.title: Choose the product
identify.intro: The sale keeps its price and date; the product leaves the stock like any sale.

merge.title: Merge two orders
merge.intro: One sale recorded as two orders (paid half in cash, half by card…): the chosen order joins {reference}. Its items, discounts and references are kept, then it is deleted.
merge.none: No other order from the same event and source.

supplies.addedTo: Supply added to {count} order. | Supply added to {count} orders.
